title: I Hope GTA 6 Borrows a Lot From GTA 4, Says IGN Editor
description: An IGN editor shares their thoughts after playing Grand Theft Auto 4 for the first time since 2008, hoping Rockstar borrows key elements for GTA 6.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Returning to Liberty City: Why GTA 4 Still Resonates

Ever since its release in 2008, Grand Theft Auto 4 has held a distinct and legendary status within Rockstar Games' iconic franchise. Recently, a gaming media editor experienced the title for the first time since its launch year, leading to a compelling reflection: there is a significant amount of content and design philosophy within GTA 4 that they hope Rockstar chooses to borrow for the upcoming GTA 6.

While Grand Theft Auto 5 achieved unprecedented commercial dominance, massive scale, and a flourishing online ecosystem, a dedicated segment of the player base and industry critics have always argued that GTA 4 possessed a gritty realism, unmatched physics engine, and level of environmental detail that set a different kind of benchmark. This recent revisit to Liberty City sparks fresh conversations about what makes the older title so enduring.

## Bridging the Past and Future of the Franchise

As the industry looks ahead to the return of Vice City in GTA 6, players and critics frequently discuss how Rockstar will balance modern technological advancements with the grounded grit that defined their earlier works. While speculation surrounds every detail of the upcoming sequel, looking back at what made GTA 4 special offers valuable context on how open-world immersion can be crafted.

Ultimately, whether Rockstar chooses to integrate specific mechanics or narrative tones from the 2008 classic remains to be seen. However, acknowledging the strengths of past entries highlights the ongoing evolution of the franchise.

## Editor's Take

Revisiting GTA 4 reminds us of the incredible attention to physics and detail that defined an era. As anticipation builds for GTA 6, incorporating the best lessons from its predecessors could help create a truly unforgettable experience.
